allow: PowerShell($cmds = @\('py','python','python3','python3.11','python3.12'\); foreach \($c in $cmds\) { $g = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { Write-Output "$c -> $\($g.Source\)" } }; Write-Output "---registry---"; try { Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Python\\PythonCore' -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name } catch { Write-Output "no HKLM PythonCore" }; try { Get-ChildItem 'HKCU:\\SOFTWARE\\Python\\PythonCore' -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name } catch { Write-Output "no HKCU PythonCore" })
PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -ge 8000 -and $_.LocalPort -lt 9000 } | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count)
